examples.text_en: He would iterate the same words again and again.
examples.text_zh: 他会一遍又一遍地重复同样的话。

examples.text_en: Please do not iterate the question in every meeting.
examples.text_zh: 请不要在每次会议上都反复说这个问题。

examples.text_en: The itinerant man moved from town to town all year.
examples.text_zh: 这个巡回的人整年从一个镇搬到另一个镇。

examples.text_en: They lived an itinerant life, never staying in one place.
examples.text_zh: 他们过着漂泊的生活，从不在一个地方久留。

examples.text_en: We planned our itinerary before leaving for the coast.
examples.text_zh: 我们在动身去海边前规划好了行程。

examples.text_en: A flexible itinerary gives us more time to rest.
examples.text_zh: 灵活的行程让我们有更多时间休息。

examples.text_en: The box was carved from a single piece of ivory.
examples.text_zh: 这只盒子是用一整块象牙雕成的。

examples.text_en: Her skin had the warm color of ivory.
examples.text_zh: 她的皮肤带着象牙般温暖的颜色。

examples.text_en: The children began to jabber about the new game.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们开始叽叽喳喳地谈论新游戏。

examples.text_en: He would jabber on the phone for many long hours.
examples.text_zh: 他会在电话里含糊地讲上好几个小时。

examples.text_en: The small jade cup was green and clear.
examples.text_zh: 这个小玉杯碧绿而通透。

examples.text_en: She put a piece of jade on the table.
examples.text_zh: 她把一块玉放在桌子上。

examples.text_en: The jaded man had worked for many long hours.
examples.text_zh: 这个疲倦的男人已经工作了好多个小时。

examples.text_en: She felt jaded after years of the same work.
examples.text_zh: 做了多年同样的工作后，她感到厌倦了。

examples.text_en: The knife left a jagged cut on the board.
examples.text_zh: 那把刀在砧板上留下一道锯齿状的切口。

examples.text_en: We climbed along the jagged edge of the rock.
examples.text_zh: 我们沿着岩石锯齿状的边缘往上爬。

examples.text_en: A small spider sat on the door jamb.
examples.text_zh: 一只小蜘蛛趴在门框的侧柱上。

examples.text_en: He leaned against the jamb and waited.
examples.text_zh: 他靠在门框上等着。

examples.text_en: The scouts held a jamboree in the open field.
examples.text_zh: 童子军们在开阔的场地上举行了大集会。

examples.text_en: Music and games filled the yearly jamboree.
examples.text_zh: 音乐和游戏充满了这一年一度的欢乐集会。

examples.text_en: His jape made the entire table laugh.
examples.text_zh: 他的一句戏言把满桌人都逗笑了。

examples.text_en: They treated the warning as a harmless jape.
examples.text_zh: 他们把那个警告当成了无害的笑料。

examples.text_en: Their jargon was full of words I did not know.
examples.text_zh: 他们的行话里满是我不知道的词。

examples.text_en: He could not understand the jargon of the group.
examples.text_zh: 他听不懂这个团体的行话。

examples.text_en: The jarring sound made everyone in the room turn.
examples.text_zh: 刺耳的声响让房间里的每个人都转过头。

examples.text_en: There was a jarring note in his happy song.
examples.text_zh: 他那首欢快的歌里有一个不和谐的音。

examples.text_en: The baby was born with a mild jaundice.
examples.text_zh: 这个婴儿出生时带有轻微的黄疸。

examples.text_en: Doctors treat jaundice with special light.
examples.text_zh: 医生用特殊的光线治疗黄疸。

examples.text_en: He had a jaundiced view of the new plan.
examples.text_zh: 他对这项新计划抱有偏见的看法。

examples.text_en: Her jaundiced eye saw faults everywhere.
examples.text_zh: 她那带偏见的眼光到哪里都能看出毛病。

examples.text_en: We took a short jaunt into the green hills.
examples.text_zh: 我们到绿色的山丘间作了一次短途远足。

examples.text_en: Their weekend jaunt lasted only two days.
examples.text_zh: 他们的周末出游只持续了两天。

examples.text_en: He walked with a jaunty step down the street.
examples.text_zh: 他迈着轻快的步子沿街走去。

examples.text_en: She had a jaunty way and felt very happy.
examples.text_zh: 她举止活泼，感到非常快乐。

examples.text_en: The group began to jeer at the young man.
examples.text_zh: 那群人开始嘲笑这个年轻人。

examples.text_en: They would jeer at him for his simple words.
examples.text_zh: 他们会因为他简单的话而讥笑他。

examples.text_en: His jejune talk about life made us all feel bad.
examples.text_zh: 他关于人生的枯燥言论让我们都很难受。

examples.text_en: The jejune land gave them nothing at all.
examples.text_zh: 这片贫瘠的土地什么也长不出来。

examples.text_en: The mistake put the entire project in jeopardy.
examples.text_zh: 那个错误使整个项目陷入危险。

examples.text_en: His job was in jeopardy after the argument.
examples.text_zh: 争吵之后他的工作岌岌可危。

examples.text_en: He made a jesting remark about my new hat.
examples.text_zh: 他就我的新帽子开了句玩笑。

examples.text_en: Her jesting tone told us not to worry.
examples.text_zh: 她打趣的语气告诉我们不必担心。

examples.text_en: The crew had to jettison the heavy cargo.
examples.text_zh: 船员们不得不抛弃沉重的货物。

examples.text_en: They will jettison the plan if costs rise.
examples.text_zh: 如果成本上升，他们将放弃这项计划。

examples.text_en: The crown was set with a large jewel.
examples.text_zh: 那顶王冠上镶着一颗巨大的宝石。

examples.text_en: She kept the shining jewel in a small box.
examples.text_zh: 她把那颗闪亮的宝石收在一只小盒子里。

examples.text_en: They kept many jewels in a small dark room.
examples.text_zh: 他们把许多珠宝保存在一间昏暗的小房间里。

examples.text_en: Her jewels were clear and beautiful in the light.
examples.text_zh: 她的珠宝在灯光下晶莹美丽。

examples.text_en: His story did not jibe with the facts.
examples.text_zh: 他的说法与事实不符。

examples.text_en: The two accounts jibe on every important point.
examples.text_zh: 这两份陈述在每个要点上都一致。

examples.text_en: He cut the board with a small jigsaw.
examples.text_zh: 他用一把小线锯锯开了木板。

examples.text_en: The children worked on a jigsaw all evening.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们整晚都在拼一幅拼图。

examples.text_en: The jingle of the small things was clear and light.
examples.text_zh: 细小物件的叮当声清脆而轻盈。

examples.text_en: She heard the jingle of money in his hand.
examples.text_zh: 她听见他手里钱币的叮当声。

examples.text_en: The speech was full of jingoism and empty pride.
examples.text_zh: 那篇讲话满是沙文主义和空洞的骄傲。

examples.text_en: Critics warned against the rising jingoism.
examples.text_zh: 批评者们对日益抬头的沙文主义发出警告。

examples.text_en: He began to jitter before the big test.
examples.text_zh: 大考之前他开始紧张不安。

examples.text_en: Some people jitter when they have to talk in public.
examples.text_zh: 有些人在需要公开讲话时会战战兢兢。

examples.text_en: The jockey won the race with a great run.
examples.text_zh: 这位骑师凭借出色的发挥赢得了比赛。

examples.text_en: He worked as a jockey for many long years.
examples.text_zh: 他当了很多年的赛马骑师。

examples.text_en: His jocose words made the meeting feel light and easy.
examples.text_zh: 他诙谐的话让会议气氛轻松愉快。

examples.text_en: She had a jocose way of talking with friends.
examples.text_zh: 她和朋友说话时总带着戏谑的口吻。

examples.text_en: The jocular man made everyone feel happy at work.
examples.text_zh: 这个诙谐的男人让每个人工作时都很开心。

examples.text_en: His jocular words helped the group through a hard day.
examples.text_zh: 他诙谐的话帮助团队度过了艰难的一天。

examples.text_en: The jocund group talked and played all night.
examples.text_zh: 这个欢乐的团体整晚又说又玩。

examples.text_en: He had a jocund way that made people feel good.
examples.text_zh: 他有一种让人愉快的快活劲儿。

examples.text_en: The jolly man greeted everyone at the door.
examples.text_zh: 那个快活的男人在门口向每个人问好。

examples.text_en: We had a jolly evening with our friends.
examples.text_zh: 我们和朋友们度过了一个愉快的夜晚。

examples.text_en: The bus gave a sudden jolt at the corner.
examples.text_zh: 公交车在拐角处猛地一颠。

examples.text_en: She felt a jolt when the plane touched down.
examples.text_zh: 飞机着陆时她感到一阵震动。

examples.text_en: The jolting of the cart woke the baby.
examples.text_zh: 马车的颠簸把婴儿弄醒了。

examples.text_en: Every jolting on the rough road hurt his back.
examples.text_zh: 在崎岖的路上每颠一下都让他的背发痛。

examples.text_en: He did not care a jot about their words.
examples.text_zh: 他一点也不在乎他们说的话。

examples.text_en: There is not a jot of truth in that story.
examples.text_zh: 那个故事里没有一丁点真实。

examples.text_en: She won a prize for her journalistic work.
examples.text_zh: 她因自己的新闻工作而获奖。

examples.text_en: The paper follows high journalistic standards.
examples.text_zh: 这家报纸遵循很高的新闻标准。

examples.text_en: The host was jovial and made us feel welcome.
examples.text_zh: 主人很欢快，让我们感到宾至如归。

examples.text_en: His jovial laugh filled the busy kitchen.
examples.text_zh: 他那欢快的笑声充满了忙碌的厨房。

examples.text_en: The crowd gave a joyous shout when they won.
examples.text_zh: 他们获胜时人群发出了欢乐的呼喊。

examples.text_en: It was a joyous day for the young family.
examples.text_zh: 对这个年轻家庭来说，那是快乐的一天。

examples.text_en: The jubilant group ran out to meet the team.
examples.text_zh: 这支欢欣鼓舞的队伍跑出去迎接团队。

examples.text_en: She felt jubilant after hearing the great news.
examples.text_zh: 听到这个好消息后，她喜气洋洋。

examples.text_en: There was great jubilation in the town that night.
examples.text_zh: 那天晚上，镇上一片欢腾。

examples.text_en: Their jubilation lasted for many days after the win.
examples.text_zh: 胜利之后，他们的欢庆持续了许多天。

examples.text_en: The judicial system must protect every citizen.
examples.text_zh: 司法制度必须保护每一位公民。

examples.text_en: A judicial review will decide the matter.
examples.text_zh: 一项司法审查将对此事作出裁决。

examples.text_en: A judicious use of time saves much effort.
examples.text_zh: 明智地利用时间能省下许多力气。

examples.text_en: She made a judicious choice of words.
examples.text_zh: 她措辞十分明智。

examples.text_en: His judiciousness in dealing with money impressed us.
examples.text_zh: 他处理钱财时的明智给我们留下了深刻印象。

examples.text_en: The plan shows great care and judiciousness.
examples.text_zh: 这项计划显示出极大的谨慎与明智。

examples.text_en: She filled the jug with cold water.
examples.text_zh: 她把水壶灌满了凉水。

examples.text_en: The jug fell and broke on the floor.
examples.text_zh: 水壶掉在地上摔碎了。

examples.text_en: The great juggernaut took over everything in its way.
examples.text_zh: 这个巨大的主宰碾压了挡路的一切。

examples.text_en: They felt small before the power of the juggernaut.
examples.text_zh: 在这个主宰的力量面前，他们显得很渺小。

examples.text_en: He can juggle three balls at the same time.
examples.text_zh: 他能同时抛接三个球。

examples.text_en: She had to juggle work and family every single day.
examples.text_zh: 她每天都要在工作与家庭之间周旋。

examples.text_en: Her books and papers jumble together on the desk.
examples.text_zh: 她的书和文件杂乱地堆在桌上。

examples.text_en: All the wires jumble together behind the machine.
examples.text_zh: 所有电线在机器后面乱成一团。

examples.text_en: At this juncture, we should stop and think.
examples.text_zh: 在这个关头，我们应该停下来想一想。

examples.text_en: The two lines meet at a single juncture.
examples.text_zh: 这两条线在一个接合点相交。

examples.text_en: This case is not within the jurisdiction of that court.
examples.text_zh: 这个案子不在那家法院的管辖范围内。

examples.text_en: The police had no jurisdiction over the small town.
examples.text_zh: 警方对这个小镇没有管辖权。

examples.text_en: He studied jurisprudence for many years at the university.
examples.text_zh: 他在大学里研习法律学许多年。

examples.text_en: The book on jurisprudence was long and hard to read.
examples.text_zh: 这本法律学著作又长又难读。

examples.text_en: His fear was justifiable given what he had seen.
examples.text_zh: 考虑到他所看到的，他的恐惧是情有可原的。

examples.text_en: They felt the decision was justifiable and right.
examples.text_zh: 他们觉得这个决定是有理且正确的。

examples.text_en: He offered no justification for coming home late.
examples.text_zh: 他对晚回家没有给出任何解释。

examples.text_en: There is no justification for such an act.
examples.text_zh: 这样的行为没有任何正当理由。

examples.text_en: He was justly proud of his daughter's success.
examples.text_zh: 他理应为女儿的成功感到自豪。

examples.text_en: The workers were justly paid for their effort.
examples.text_zh: 工人们凭自己的付出得到了公正的报酬。

examples.text_en: The book will juxtapose day and night in one page.
examples.text_zh: 这本书会把白天和黑夜并列在一页之中。

examples.text_en: He tried to juxtapose the two ideas side by side.
examples.text_zh: 他试图把这两个想法并排放置。

examples.text_en: The juxtaposition of the two words was very clear.
examples.text_zh: 这两个词并置在一起，对比非常鲜明。

examples.text_en: She loved the juxtaposition of light and dark.
examples.text_zh: 她喜欢光与暗的并列对照。

examples.text_en: The child looked into the kaleidoscope for many hours.
examples.text_zh: 这个孩子对着万花筒看了好几个小时。

examples.text_en: The city was a kaleidoscope of light and life.
examples.text_zh: 这座城市是光与生活的万花筒。

examples.text_en: The city lights made a kaleidoscopic pattern.
examples.text_zh: 城市的灯光形成了一幅千变万化的图案。

examples.text_en: Her paintings show a kaleidoscopic mix of colors.
examples.text_zh: 她的画呈现出万花筒般缤纷的色彩。

examples.text_en: He wrote a few keywords on the small page.
examples.text_zh: 他在那张小纸上写了几个关键词。

examples.text_en: The keywords help people find the right website.
examples.text_zh: 这些关键词能帮助人们找到正确的网站。

examples.text_en: The doctor said his kidney was working well.
examples.text_zh: 医生说他的肾工作正常。

examples.text_en: She donated a kidney to her sick brother.
examples.text_zh: 她捐了一个肾给生病的弟弟。

examples.text_en: No one likes a killjoy at a happy party.
examples.text_zh: 在欢乐的聚会上，没有人喜欢扫兴的人。

examples.text_en: They called him a killjoy for stopping the game.
examples.text_zh: 他们叫他扫兴鬼，因为他叫停了游戏。

examples.text_en: The pots are baked in a hot kiln.
examples.text_zh: 这些陶罐在炽热的窑里烧制。

examples.text_en: Smoke rose from the kiln all afternoon.
examples.text_zh: 整个下午窑里都在冒烟。

examples.text_en: This machine uses about one kilowatt of power.
examples.text_zh: 这台机器大约使用一千瓦的电力。

examples.text_en: The new system saves a full kilowatt each day.
examples.text_zh: 新系统每天能省下整整一千瓦的电。

examples.text_en: All his kin came to the family meeting that day.
examples.text_zh: 那天他所有的亲戚都来参加了家庭聚会。

examples.text_en: She felt close to her kin even from far away.
examples.text_zh: 即使相隔很远，她也觉得自己与亲人很亲近。

examples.text_en: He used dry leaves to kindle the fire.
examples.text_zh: 他用干树叶把火点着。

examples.text_en: The story kindled her interest in science.
examples.text_zh: 这个故事激起了她对科学的兴趣。

examples.text_en: He felt a kindred spirit in the young writer.
examples.text_zh: 他在那位年轻作家身上感到一种亲近。

examples.text_en: They shared kindred views on art and life.
examples.text_zh: 他们在艺术和生活上有着相似的观点。

examples.text_en: The kinetic power of the moving car was great.
examples.text_zh: 行驶中汽车的运动能量很大。

examples.text_en: They studied kinetic energy in the small school room.
examples.text_zh: 他们在那间小教室里研究动能。

examples.text_en: The two men felt a strong kinship from the start.
examples.text_zh: 这两个男人从一开始就感到一种强烈的亲缘关系。

examples.text_en: Their kinship was clear to everyone in the family.
examples.text_zh: 他们之间的亲属关系家里每个人都清楚。

examples.text_en: We bought a newspaper at the small kiosk.
examples.text_zh: 我们在那个小报摊买了一份报纸。

examples.text_en: The kiosk near the station sells cold drinks.
examples.text_zh: 车站附近的那个亭子卖冷饮。

examples.text_en: They brought their small kits on the long trip.
examples.text_zh: 他们在长途旅行中带上了自己的小工具箱。

examples.text_en: The kits were full of the things we needed.
examples.text_zh: 这些装备里装满了我们需要的东西。

examples.text_en: He packed his knapsack for the long walk.
examples.text_zh: 他为长途步行收拾好了背包。

examples.text_en: Her knapsack was heavy with books and food.
examples.text_zh: 她的背包里塞满了书和食物，很沉。

examples.text_en: The knave took the money and ran from town.
examples.text_zh: 这个恶棍拿了钱便逃出了城。

examples.text_en: Everyone knew him as a knave and a bad man.
examples.text_zh: 大家都知道他是个恶棍，也是个坏人。

examples.text_en: She began to knead the food with her hands.
examples.text_zh: 她开始用双手揉捏食物。

examples.text_en: He had to knead the hard thing for an hour.
examples.text_zh: 他不得不把那个硬东西揉了一个小时。

examples.text_en: The bell rang a slow knell for the dead.
examples.text_zh: 钟声为死者缓缓响起，如同丧钟。

examples.text_en: Many heard the knell across the quiet town.
examples.text_zh: 许多人在安静的镇上听到了那丧钟声。

examples.text_en: A single tree stood on the grassy knoll.
examples.text_zh: 一棵树孤零零地立在那座长满草的小丘上。

examples.text_en: The children ran down the small knoll.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们跑下了那座小丘。

examples.text_en: The lawyers faced a knotty problem in the case.
examples.text_zh: 律师们在这起案件中遇到了一个棘手的问题。

examples.text_en: This is a knotty question with no easy answer.
examples.text_zh: 这是个棘手的问题，没有简单的答案。

examples.text_en: The job requires technical know-how and patience.
examples.text_zh: 这份工作需要技术诀窍和耐心。

examples.text_en: Her know-how saved the team much time.
examples.text_zh: 她的诀窍为团队省下了许多时间。

examples.text_en: She was very knowledgeable about the history of art.
examples.text_zh: 她对艺术史非常了解。

examples.text_en: The knowledgeable man answered every question with care.
examples.text_zh: 这位有学识的人认真地回答了每一个问题。

examples.text_en: She earned kudos for her fine reporting.
examples.text_zh: 她因出色的报道赢得了赞誉。

examples.text_en: The young team deserves kudos for this win.
examples.text_zh: 这支年轻的队伍配得上这次胜利的赞誉。

examples.text_en: The kymograph recorded the small changes over the day.
examples.text_zh: 这台记录仪记录下了这一天中的细微变化。

examples.text_en: They used a kymograph to study the moving line.
examples.text_zh: 他们用一台记录仪来研究那条移动的线。

examples.text_en: His labile feelings changed from day to day.
examples.text_zh: 他的情绪起伏不定，一天一个样。

examples.text_en: The labile state of the market was hard to take.
examples.text_zh: 市场易变的状态让人难以承受。

examples.text_en: His labored breathing worried the nurse.
examples.text_zh: 他吃力的呼吸让护士担忧。

examples.text_en: The speech had a labored and formal tone.
examples.text_zh: 这篇讲话带着一种吃力而正式的语气。

examples.text_en: The laborer worked hard under the hot sun all day.
examples.text_zh: 这个体力劳动者在烈日下辛苦工作了一整天。

examples.text_en: A young laborer moved the boxes to the room.
examples.text_zh: 一个年轻的工人把箱子搬到了房间里。

examples.text_en: Copying the files by hand was a laborious task.
examples.text_zh: 手工抄写这些文件是件费劲的活。

examples.text_en: They began the laborious work of cleaning the hall.
examples.text_zh: 他们开始了打扫大厅的艰苦工作。

examples.text_en: He walked laboriously up the long hard road.
examples.text_zh: 他吃力地沿着那条漫长难行的路往上走。

examples.text_en: She wrote the words laboriously on the small page.
examples.text_zh: 她在小纸上一笔一画地费力写下这些字。

examples.text_en: The labourer had worked on the land for years.
examples.text_zh: 这个劳工在这片土地上工作了许多年。

examples.text_en: They paid the labourer a little money each week.
examples.text_zh: 他们每周付给这个劳工一点钱。

examples.text_en: The narrow streets formed a true labyrinth.
examples.text_zh: 狭窄的街道构成了一个真正的迷宫。

examples.text_en: We got lost in the labyrinth of small rooms.
examples.text_zh: 我们在小房间组成的迷宫里迷了路。

examples.text_en: The hard thing can lacerate the hand in a second.
examples.text_zh: 这个坚硬的东西一瞬间就能划破手。

examples.text_en: His hard words seemed to lacerate her heart.
examples.text_zh: 他那些无情的话仿佛撕裂了她的心。

examples.text_en: The laceration on his arm was long and deep.
examples.text_zh: 他手臂上的伤口又长又深。

examples.text_en: They cleaned the laceration and put a cover on it.
examples.text_zh: 他们清理了伤口，并在上面敷了东西。

examples.text_en: The play was a lachrymose story of loss.
examples.text_zh: 这部戏是一个爱流泪的失落故事。

examples.text_en: Her lachrymose mood lasted the entire day.
examples.text_zh: 她那爱哭的情绪持续了一整天。

examples.text_en: His lackadaisical attitude annoyed the busy manager.
examples.text_zh: 他那懒散的态度让忙碌的经理很恼火。

examples.text_en: She gave a lackadaisical wave and walked away.
examples.text_zh: 她懒洋洋地挥了挥手就走开了。

examples.text_en: The manager treated his assistant like a lackey.
examples.text_zh: 那个经理对待他的助手就像对待仆人一样。

examples.text_en: He acted as a willing lackey for the boss.
examples.text_zh: 他心甘情愿地给老板当马屁精。

examples.text_en: The show was dull and rather lackluster.
examples.text_zh: 这场演出沉闷而没有生气。

examples.text_en: His lackluster performance failed to impress the crowd.
examples.text_zh: 他平淡的表演没能打动观众。

examples.text_en: His laconic answer said more than a long talk.
examples.text_zh: 他简洁的回答胜过一番长篇大论。

examples.text_en: She had a laconic style that everyone respected.
examples.text_zh: 她有自己简洁的风格，人人都很敬重。

examples.text_en: The lactic food was light and easy to take.
examples.text_zh: 这种乳制食品清淡，容易接受。

examples.text_en: They studied the lactic part of the food.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究了这种食物中来自乳汁的部分。

examples.text_en: The trees were laden with ripe red apples.
examples.text_zh: 树上挂满了熟透的红苹果。

examples.text_en: She came home laden with bags and gifts.
examples.text_zh: 她提着大包小包的礼物回到家。

examples.text_en: The laggard was soon far behind the rest.
examples.text_zh: 这个落后者很快就远远落在了别人后面。

examples.text_en: They did not want to be seen as a laggard.
examples.text_zh: 他们不想被人看作落伍者。

examples.text_en: The water in the small lagoon was clear and green.
examples.text_zh: 这个小泻湖里的水清澈碧绿。

examples.text_en: They found a safe lagoon near the open sea.
examples.text_zh: 他们在开阔的大海附近找到了一个安全的泻湖。

examples.text_en: They found a lair deep in the dark night.
examples.text_zh: 他们在黑夜深处发现了一个兽窝。

examples.text_en: The lair was among the high dark walls.
examples.text_zh: 这个兽窝藏在又高又暗的墙壁之间。
